newsitem.title: UK: Bookmaker says wagers on low U.S. payrolls number.
newsitem.headline: Bookmaker says wagers on low U.S. payrolls number.

text.p: While activity on world finanical markets has comes to a grinding halt ahead of the release of the crucial U.S. non-farm payrolls report, a London-based bookmaker is busy making markets on what the actual number will be.
City Index Ltd said it took in some 85 bets from financial and non-financial professionals alike on how many new non-agricultural jobs were created in the U.S. last month.
"The bets and coming in thick and fast," said one dealer with the firm.
He said City Index, which is making a market on the U.S. economic statistic for the third straight month, has taken on roughly 100,000 stg in risk.
Gamblers are setting their wagers on a number below 225,000 new jobs, he said.
That figure, which would bode well for equity and debt markets, is below the 244,000 forecasted by economists surveyed by Reuters.
The report is due for release at 1230 GMT.
